title: v2 deterministic witness corner — PHASE 1 small-n byte-close smoke (REAL inflate.sh -> upstream/evaluate.py, CPU)
eval_path: REAL: archive.zip -> unzip -> inflate.sh -> inflate.py (NO scorer weights) -> inflated/0.raw -> upstream/evaluate.py --device cpu
eval_note: upstream/evaluate.sh calls bare `python` (not on PATH locally) -> ran upstream/evaluate.py directly with .venv python after the sh-driven unzip+inflate. Small-n via --batch-size n so the n-pair comp is exactly ONE full batch matching the GT batch (avoids the partial-last-batch shape-mismatch assertion). zip(dl_gt,dl_comp) stops after that batch -> scores the first n pairs of 0.mkv.

false_authority.evidence_grade: contest-CPU (LOCAL macOS x86-emulated? NO -> Apple-silicon CPU torch). Tag: [macOS-CPU advisory] for the SCORE AXIS; the d_seg/d_pose/byte components are REAL upstream evaluate.py outputs but on Apple-silicon CPU, NOT contest GHA Linux x86_64. Promotion requires Linux x86_64 [contest-CPU] AND/OR [contest-CUDA].
false_authority.distortion_axis: GROUNDED but ADVISORY-for-n600 (per-pair avg over the FIRST 24 pairs only; may not represent all 600).
false_authority.rate_axis: GROUNDED at small-n; n600 rate is PROJECTED (linear per-pair byte scaling).
false_authority.frontier_pointer: UNMOVED at contest-CPU 0.19110 (.omx/state/canonical_frontier_pointer.json). NO pointer move claimed. None of these rows is a frontier candidate.

apparatus_validation.claim: A perfect-reconstruction (lossless) witness scores EXACTLY d_seg=0, d_pose=0 through the real eval, proving the full pipeline + GT pair-ordering + small-n truncation harness are trustworthy.
apparatus_validation.parity_all_rows: inflate output 0.raw byte-equals the build-time render oracle for ALL modes (deterministic integer decode confirmed).

rate_budget_context.approx_frontier_archive_bytes: ~177000 (rate ~0.0047 -> 25*rate ~0.118); sub-0.19 needs the WHOLE 600-pair archive <~180KB i.e. <~300 bytes/pair.
rate_budget_context.implication: Any per-pair pixel storage must be <~300 bytes/pair to fit. Measured per-pair below is 50KB-3.4MB -> 150x-11000x over budget.

grounded_rows_n24.desc: identity witness: store both frames losslessly (zlib). Proves pipeline + parity; bounds the rate of lossless per-pair storage.

v2 deterministic corner, simplest form: store f0 (zlib) + 6-dof pose, f1 = per-class-pose-warp(f0) with NO residual (integer-deterministic decode). The crude per-class warp = top20%=identity(sky) / middle=road integer roll <=6px from pose / bottom22%=identity(hood).
grounded_rows_n24.verdict: POSE-CATASTROPHIC + RATE-DEAD. The crude integer warp produces ~static frames -> PoseNet reads ~no ego-motion -> d_pose=190 (frontier ~3.4e-5). The warp MUST be the real ground-homography (genuinely move the scene by the pose) to carry d_pose. f0 stored raw -> rate also dead.

grounded_rows_n24.desc: lossy per-pair storage with a REAL codec (JPEG q40, PIL decode at inflate = legal external lib). Isolates whether the RATE half is solvable by coding, independent of any warp, and how robust the SCORER is to lossy content.
grounded_rows_n24.verdict: DISTORTION FINE, RATE-DEAD. SegNet/PoseNet are ROBUST to JPEG q40 (d_seg 0.0021 ~3.5x frontier; d_pose 0.013 -> contributes 0.366). The blocker is PURELY rate: 50KB/pair = 167x over the ~300 byte/pair budget.

n600_projections.method: rate = per_pair_bytes*600/37545489 (linear); distortion carried from n24 advisory avg (NOT re-measured at n600).

verdict.byte_closes: YES — 3 REAL byte-closed exact-eval rows through the actual inflate.sh -> evaluate.py path on CPU. archive.zip is self-contained (NO scorer weights). The win for PHASE 1 (a real measurement + validated apparatus) is secured.
verdict.parity: YES — inflate output byte-equals the render oracle for every mode (deterministic integer/codec decode).
verdict.clears_0p19_at_n600: NO — and not close. The SIMPLEST per-pair-storage deterministic corner is FAR worse than 0.19 (n600 S projected 20.6-1347.8), dominated by RATE by 150x-450x. It is NOT PR95-adjacent (~0.19); it is much worse, because per-pair pixel storage in ANY form (raw/warp-keyframe/JPEG) cannot get within 100x of the ~180KB sub-0.19 rate budget.
verdict.decisive_structural_finding: The scorer is ROBUST to lossy pixel content (store_jpeg q40 d_seg 0.0021) -> the corner does NOT need pixel fidelity. The corner's viability hinges ENTIRELY on the RATE term, and storing PER-PAIR content is structurally impossible (150x-450x over budget). The crude warp is separately pose-catastrophic (d_pose 190).
what_the_corner_actually_requires: MUST NOT store per-pair content. Viable form = a SHARED canonical (one or few keyframes across many frames) + the 600x6 pose trajectory (~14KB) + a REAL ground-homography per-class warp that GENERATES frames (so PoseNet reads the right ego-motion) + a TINY task-survival residual (lane-edge survival + small movables).
Real ground-homography warp from comma2k19 intrinsics + 6-dof pose (replaces the d_pose=190 crude integer roll).
A real clustering/range/entropy residual coder for the lane-survival + movables sidecar (the FEED-ko ~0.103 coding path).
Whether the ambitious shared-canonical form clears 0.19 is UNMEASURED in PHASE 1 — it is the next build. PHASE 1 de-risked the eval apparatus so that build can be measured identically.
verdict.honest_scope: GROUNDED: byte-close works, apparatus validated (lossless -> 0/0), 3 real exact rows, per-pair storage rate-dead (measured), crude warp pose-catastrophic (measured), scorer robust to JPEG (measured). PROJECTED/UNBUILT: the ambitious shared-canonical + real-homography + residual-coder corner (the only form that could clear 0.19) is build-gated and unmeasured.
